claims.claim: Our machines are pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance landmarks and they come with...
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an electric pressure washer with hose/cable and nozzle area visible, but no certification document, test video, or included accessories are shown.

risks.risk: Not working or weak pressure (no proof it starts, builds pressure, and sprays consistently).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the washer starting from cold, building pressure, and spraying a steady jet for at least 30–60 seconds (showing the gauge/pressure output if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified working condition (worst-case: may need repair/servicing).

risks.risk: Missing key accessories (spray gun/lance, correct nozzle tips, hose ends/quick-connects).
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip laid out showing the complete set: spray gun/trigger, lance/wand, all nozzle tips, high-pressure hose ends/quick-connects, and any included fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Wear or damage at seals, trigger/gun, and hose connections causing leaks or poor performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: trigger/gun connection points, high-pressure hose ends/threads/quick-connects, and any visible seals/o-rings (both sides).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak/seal wear (worst-case: may require seal replacement).

risks.risk: Electrical/motor issues or wrong voltage rating for Lagos use.
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate/label showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V), frequency, and model/motor specs; plus a brief power-on test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown electrical compatibility/specs (worst-case: may not match local power or needs servicing).

risks.risk: Physical damage or corrosion on body/fittings not visible from a single angle.
risks.proof: Multiple angles including underside and all fittings: close-ups of any cracks, rust, bent frame, or damaged hose routing points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average used condition with possible hidden wear (worst-case: damage may affect reliability).

proof_requests: Send a video of the pressure washer starting and spraying a steady jet for 30–60 seconds (showing trigger operation).
Show a full set photo/clip of all included parts: spray gun/trigger, lance/wand, nozzle tips, high-pressure hose ends/quick-connects, and any other attachments.
Provide close-up photos of the trigger/gun connection, hose ends, and any visible seals/o-rings.
Provide a clear photo of the rating plate/label (voltage and model specs).
Send additional angles to check for cracks/rust/damage on the body and fittings.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as an electric pressure washer, so it can be priced at its worst-case used scenario. Seller certification/performance claims are not verifiable from the report, so the price should assume possible servicing needs and unknown completeness.
